fixed_model: N=2^m, m>=3; T=3I+L+L^T+E_00; P reverses all m bits; A=TP; C=PT=A^T; original full band |i-j|<=2; t=N/4+1

commutator_theorem.conclusion: K=[T,PTP]=A^2-(A^2)^T has exactly 4m-4 supported rows/columns; rank is 4m-6 for even m and 4m-8 for odd m.
commutator_theorem.reason: Division-free kernel parametrization; no inverse of T is used.

woodbury_and_two_channel_system.domain: Over Q in the accepted packet. The same algebra is valid over another field only when T is invertible there.
woodbury_and_two_channel_system.condition: T invertible, so A,B=A^2 and B^T are invertible.
woodbury_and_two_channel_system.conclusion: M=I-K_S E^T B^(-1)E has determinant one and the stated inverse correction is valid.
woodbury_and_two_channel_system.excluded_inference: The all-field commutator theorem does not establish T invertibility or original-chart regularity in every field.

symmetric_skew_decomposition.domain: Over Q; more generally characteristic not two with T invertible
symmetric_skew_decomposition.reason: Splitting W=(W+W^T)/2+(W-W^T)/2 requires division by two.

original_chart_transport.domain: Characteristic zero at the specified good rational anchor
guards: Nonzero leading and trailing principal minors
original_chart_transport.status: Preserved from the pinned accepted source, not extended to every finite-field reduction.
